paite: Huchi in Ammon mi Nahash ahong kisa a, Jabesh-gilead sual tum in ava giahkhum hi. Jabesh mi tengteng in Nahash kiang ah, "Kou toh thukhun bawl in, huchi in nang nna ka sem ding uh," achi uh.
heading: Saul In Ammonte Azou

paite: Ammon mi Nahash in akiang uah, "Hichibang in ahi nou toh thu ka khun ding. Na mit taklam tengteng uh khelkhiak vek ahi dia; huai Israel mi tengteng minsiatna dia koih ahi ding," achi hi.
Jabesh khua upate'n akiang ah, "Israel gam tengteng a thupo mite ka sawltheihna ding un ni sagih sung hon hungaih in. Hon hondam ding kuamah a-om keileh na kiang ah ka hong paikhe ding uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in huai thupo mite Saul omna khua Gibeah ahong tung uhi. Mite bil azak in huai thute agen ua; mite aw suah in akap uhi,
Ngai in, lou a pan bawng hawl in Saul ahong pai hi. Saul in, "Bang achi ua ahia mite akah uh?" achi hi. Jabesh a mite thugen ahilh uhi.
Huai thu azaktak in Saul tung ah Pathian Kha ahong tung a nakpitak in ahehta hi.

Huchi in bawngtal nih ala a, asemnen vek hi. Israel gam tengteng ah thupo mite ahawmsak a, "Kuapeuh Saul leh Samuel zui nuam lou peuhmah hiai bawngtal bang a hih ahi ding," achi hi. Huchi in mipite'n TOUPA alau ua, thukhat sat in ahong kuankheta uh.
Bezek ah amaute asim a, Israel mite nuaithum ahi uh. Judah mite singthum ahi uh.

Ahong pai thupo mite kiang ah, "Jabesh-gilead mite kiang ah, zingchiang in nisat san laitak mah in hotkhiak na hi ding uh va chi un," achi hi. Thupo mite ava hoh ua, Jabesh mite ahilh ua, huchi in akipak mahmah uhi.
Huchi in Jabesh mite'n, "Zingchiang in na kiang uah ka hong pawtkhe ding ua, ka tung uah na ut-ut un hih mai un," achi uhi.

Hichi ahong hi a, azing in Saul in mipite pawl thum in akoih a, zing ven hun laitak in agiahmun uah alut uhi. Ammon mite sun nisat san lai tan in athat uhi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, athahvalte adalhzak vek ua, nih a omkhawm himhim leng a-om kei uhi.
Mipite'n Samuel kiang ah, "Kuate ahia, Saul in i tung uah vai ahawm tel ding maw chi? Huai mite hon pi in ka that ding uh," achi uhi.
Saul in, "Tuni chitchiat in zaw kuamah that kei un. Tuni in TOUPA'N Israelte lak ah hotdamna abawlta ngal a," achi hi.
Huchi in Samuel in mipite kiang ah, "Kisa dih uh, Gilgal ah i hoh ding ua, huai ah lalgam i thaksak nawn ding uh," achi hi.

Huchi in mite tengteng Gilgal ah ahohta uhi. Saul Gilgal ah TOUPA ma ah kumpipa in abawlta uhi. Huai ah TOUPA ma ah lemna kithoihnate alan uhi. Huchi in huai ah Saul leh Israel mi tengteng akipak mahmah uhi.
